XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='LegacyPlusAdtHl7:ADT_LegPlus' targetDocType='LegacyPlusAdtHl7:ADT_LegPlus' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>DTL for Medicalis Adt from Legacy Adt</annotation> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.processingId ' property='target.{MSH:ProcessingID.processingID}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent} = "A34"' > <true> <assign value='"A30"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{PID:Sex} = "B"' > <true> <assign value='"O"' property='target.{PID:Sex}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{PID:MaritalStatus.identifier} = "X"' > <true> <assign value='"A"' property='target.{PID:MaritalStatus.identifier}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{EVN:EventTypeCode} = "A34"' > <true> <assign value='"A30"' property='target.{EVN:EventTypeCode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='"MEDICALIS"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.facilityId' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingFacility.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{MRG(1)} '=""' > <true> <assign value='source.{MRG}' property='target.{MRG}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{PV1}' property='target.{PV1}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.pv131PointOfCareRep' property='target.{PV1:AssignedPatientLocation.pointofcare}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.pv134FacilityHDRep' property='target.{PV1:AssignedPatientLocation.facilityHD}' action='set' /> </transform>
